name: profile-page
title: Profile page
description: A person's page: a taped polaroid holding their photo (or initials) with the name, words, follow and message beside it, four numbers on slips, and three tabs. Activity is pages written week by week in tally marks (this week in marker) and a feed under the day it happened; Notebooks is a shelf of closed covers; Stickers shows the ones earned and, faint, what it takes to earn the rest. The text sits on the page itself, so it reads the same on paper or on the desk.

"use client"

import * as React from "react"

import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs"
import { ProfilePageActivity } from "@/components/blocks/profile-page/components/profile-page-activity"
import { PROFILE, type Profile } from "@/components/blocks/profile-page/components/profile-page-data"
import { ProfilePageHeader } from "@/components/blocks/profile-page/components/profile-page-header"
import { ProfilePageNotebooks, ProfilePageStickers } from "@/components/blocks/profile-page/components/profile-page-shelf"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

type Props = {
  className?: string
  profile?: Profile
  defaultFollowing?: boolean
  onFollowChange?: (following: boolean) => void
  onMessage?: () => void
}

export default function ProfilePage({ className, profile = PROFILE, defaultFollowing = false, onFollowChange, onMessage }: Props) {
  const [following, setFollowing] = React.useState(defaultFollowing)
  return (
    <section aria-label={`${profile.name}, profile`} className={cn("@container/profile mx-auto grid w-full max-w-6xl gap-12 px-4 py-12 sm:px-8", className)}>
      <ProfilePageHeader
        profile={profile}
        following={following}
        onFollow={(next) => {
          setFollowing(next)
          onFollowChange?.(next)
        }}
        onMessage={onMessage}
      />
      <Tabs defaultValue="activity" className="gap-6">
        <TabsList variant="line" aria-label="Profile sections">
          <TabsTrigger value="activity">Activity</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="notebooks">Notebooks</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="stickers">Stickers</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="activity">
          <ProfilePageActivity weeks={profile.weeks} feed={profile.feed} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="notebooks">
          <ProfilePageNotebooks shelf={profile.shelf} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="stickers">
          <ProfilePageStickers badges={profile.badges} />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </section>
  )
}
